title: A Weekend in the Mountains
description: A family goes camping in the mountains for two days.
instructions: Read the story about a family camping trip, then answer the questions. Choose the best answer for each question.

paragraphs.text: Last summer, the Turner family went camping in the mountains for a weekend. There are four people in the family: Mr Turner, Mrs Turner, their son Leo and their daughter Mia. They left home early on Saturday morning and drove for three hours. The car was full of bags, food and a big green tent. Leo was excited, but Mia was a little nervous because it was her first time camping.

When they arrived, they put up the tent next to a small lake. It was not easy, and it took them almost an hour. In the afternoon, they walked up a hill and saw beautiful views of the valley. Mia took a lot of photos with her mother's phone. In the evening, Mr Turner cooked sausages and potatoes on a small fire.

The night was very cold, and nobody slept well. Mia heard strange noises outside the tent and woke up her brother. Leo laughed and said it was only the wind in the trees. In the morning, they saw small footprints near the tent. Mrs Turner said a fox probably came to look for food.

On Sunday, the family swam in the lake and had a picnic lunch. Then they packed everything into the car and drove home. Mia was tired but happy. She told her friends at school that camping was the best adventure of her summer. Now she wants to go again next year.

Back at home, Mia printed her best photos from the trip. Her favourite one showed the valley from the top of the hill in the evening light. She put it on the wall above her bed. Leo liked the photo of the fox footprints best, because it reminded him of Mia's scary night. He told the story to all his friends and laughed every time.

In September, Mia's teacher asked the class to write about their summer holidays. Mia wrote about the weekend in the mountains and added her photos. Her teacher said it was one of the most interesting stories in the class. Now the whole family is saving money for a bigger and warmer tent. Mr Turner says next time they are going to stay for a whole week.
